rca of the issue: Pre-fix bug: worth of eToro CFD positions was computed as quantity × current_price = leveraged notional exposure (~$31k USD / ~$44k AUD) because that formula treats positions as fully-paid shares, not margined CFDs. For a 1x NVDA position bought at $100 with current $120 and $6000 invested, the notional was 60×$120 = $7,200 but the user's actual exposure (invested + unrealized P&L) is $6,000 + 60×$20 = $7,200 — equal only at ×1. At ×2 leverage (invested $500 for 10× exposure of $1,000 notional on AMZN), notional was $1,000 but true worth is invested $500 + pnl ($-73) = $427. Across 9 positions this ballooned to $42k vs actual $17.3k USD. Fix: backend etoro_sync now fetches /trading/info/real/pnl and stores unrealizedPnL.pnL per external_position_id; investment_native/investment_worth_aud switch on source==='etoro' and return amount + pnl (not quantity × price). Frontend worthOf() mirrors the same logic with a fallback. Verified: dashboard shares_total 24,866 AUD; total_value_usd 17,329 USD; drift from user's 24,776 explained by live FX+price updates since bug report.
